claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Rifabutin is a bacterial RNA polymerase inhibitor with no meaningful activity against human cells at 2.5 uM; any apparent killing would reflect nonspecific physicochemical effects rather than a shared human cytotoxic mechanism.
